style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#334155;fontFamily=Helvetica;spacingTop=2;" value="1. Evaluation order: Center firewall evaluates top-down (CC-GST explicit denies before allows; CC-DEF-01 default deny logged); Cloud uses TGW routes + NACLs + SGs + endpoint policies.<br/>2. Zero AWS Network Firewall & no NAT GW (CL-EGR-01): centers enter private endpoints via static IKEv2 IPsec; internet ingress only via IoT mTLS and WAF front doors.<br/>3. Temporary rules (Audit): CC-LNK-06/CL-LNK-05 (QA acceptance), CC-ADM-05 (maintenance windows), CC-ADM-06 (commissioning laptop .60). Permanent rules coded in Epic 6.<br/>4. Solid blue/green = permanent allow; dashed amber = temporary/backup; dashed red = explicit deny or blackhole; dashed grey = reserved empty or not deployed." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="98" width="2022" x="49" y="1083" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
1. Evaluation order: Center firewall evaluates top-down (CC-GST explicit denies before allows; CC-DEF-01 default deny logged); Cloud uses TGW routes + NACLs + SGs + endpoint policies.
2. Zero AWS Network Firewall & no NAT GW (CL-EGR-01): centers enter private endpoints via static IKEv2 IPsec; internet ingress only via IoT mTLS and WAF front doors.
3. Temporary rules (Audit): CC-LNK-06/CL-LNK-05 (QA acceptance), CC-ADM-05 (maintenance windows), CC-ADM-06 (commissioning laptop .60). Permanent rules coded in Epic 6.
4. Solid blue/green = permanent allow; dashed amber = temporary/backup; dashed red = explicit deny or blackhole; dashed grey = reserved empty or not deployed.
